title: GitHub pilot at the prototype stage, its grant and "Refresh the overview" from chat
goal: A GitHub pilot on the roster that owns the two tools, enters at prototype, and answers "Refresh the overview" by dispatching the coordinator refresh and reporting the run
acceptance: The roster has a GitHub pilot (domain GitHub workflows, tools github.workflow.dispatch and github.runs.status, stage test by the early promotion in F-132-T01) chosen for GitHub requests like other pilots (F-045)
A dispatch requested in chat is shown as an owner-approved card; after approval the pilot watches the run with github.runs.status and replies with its result and link
Demotion signals (F-025-T04) apply to the pilot like any other
A test across chat routing, the approval gate and the fake GitHub API: "Refresh the overview" ends with one dispatch after approval and none without it
privacy: Neutral invented repositories, workflows and runs in tests; the GitHub token never in git, config.json, tests, logs, chat or the relocation snapshot.
escalation: Promoting the pilot past prototype is the owner's decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a roster entry, a grant and a chat route over existing pilots and approvals. Not a measurement.
